text: Converts price 30-day fed funds futures contract meeting month probability rate move size step, using standard month-average extraction: contract settles monthly average effective rate, pre-meeting rate applies decision day, $$r_{post} = \frac{M\,\bar r - d\, r_{pre}}{M - d}, \qquad   q = \frac{r_{post} - r_{pre}}{step},$$ \(\bar r = 100 - \mathrm{price}\), M calendar days month, d day month decision.

text: Traded event claims (prediction-market contracts, betting quotes, binary options) pay one unit resolution. price therefore discounted probability: \(\psi_t = D(t,\tau)\, q_t\), \(D(t,\tau)\) discount factor payout numeraire. function undoes discounting, alternatively removes bookmaker overround normalizing sum outcome prices book.

title: Convert event state prices into state-price-implied event probabilities — q_from_price
text: price Numeric vector raw claim prices \(\psi_t\) (0-1 scale; rescale percent quotes first). discount Numeric scalar vector, discount factor \(D(t,\tau) \(0, 1]\) applicable payout (default 1, .e. discounting). book Numeric scalar vector, sum prices outcomes market. Required method = "overround". method Character, "discount" "overround".

title: Convert event state prices into state-price-implied event probabilities — q_from_price
text: numeric vector probabilities q. Values outside \([0,1]\) trigger warning (indicate wrong discount/book), returned unchanged caller can flag rather drop .

title: Convert event state prices into state-price-implied event probabilities — q_from_price
text: Two normalizations available: method = "discount" (default): \(q = \psi / D\). result state-price-implied event probability payout numeraire (stochastic interest rates, forward-measure probability). short horizons correction basis points systematic. method = "overround": \(q_j = \psi_j / \sum_i \psi_i\), book supplies \(\sum_i \psi_i\). Use raw quotes include bookmaker margin already removed data provider. Note series already margin-adjusted must normalized twice. level distortion (approximately) constant log-odds scale — constant discount factor, constant state-price tilt — shifts \(L_t = \mathrm{logit}(q_t)\) constant therefore leaves Event Clock unchanged: quadratic variation invariant level shifts. Getting level q exactly right matters probability statements, event_clock().

title: Convert event state prices into state-price-implied event probabilities — q_from_price
code: # a 90-day claim priced at 0.19 with a 2% (annualized) short rate q_from_price(0.19, discount = exp(-0.02 * 90 / 365)) #> [1] 0.1909393  # two-sided book with overround: prices sum to 1.04 q_from_price(0.52, book = 0.52 + 0.52, method = "overround") #> [1] 0.5
